integrity: Theorem and proof given with all quantified assumptions; 960 finite spot checks and six explicit smooth quadratic dimension witnesses are supplementary to the analytic proof. Public mathematical sources are credited; mathematical novelty is subject to residual historical priority risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact Euclidean ball oracle and orthogonal separability with differentiable strictly convex even coordinate costs are essential. Does not extend to arbitrary coupled convex or nonsmooth objectives. The smooth sharpness construction has unbounded condition number as its geometric parameter vanishes; the threshold is existential, not a fixed universal numerical epsilon. Priority comparisons are bounded and independent validation has not occurred.
title: Radius-order comparison and smooth sharpness for exact ball-proximal optimization
